scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config apps/slack-agent/wrangler.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config apps/slack-agent/wrangler.deploy.json --env staging --remote
scripts.deploy:dry: WORKER_CONFIG=wrangler.jsonc CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging bun run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/slack-agent/dist/agentic_slack/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:staging: WORKER_CONFIG=wrangler.deploy.json CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging bun run build && wrangler deploy --keep-vars --config apps/slack-agent/dist/agentic_slack/wrangler.json
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run knip && bun run deploy:dry && bun audit
